title: Environmental Effect on the Interstellar Medium in Galaxies across the Cosmic Web at z = 0.73
question: How does local galaxy environment (density) affect the ISM mass, gas fraction and depletion time of star-forming galaxies at z~0.73 in the COSMOS large-scale structure?

evidence.quote: The local galaxy densities were determined from projected 2D density maps published by (cite: Scoville2013)
We show the distribution of stellar mass and local galaxy density of these targets compared to the overall COSMOS sample from (cite: Laigle2016)
All 101 target galaxies have corresponding SFR$_\mathrm{UV}$ from (cite: Lee2015).
We used the IR photometry for our 101 sources from the PEP PACS catalogs (cite: Lutz2011)
Using the visual morphological classifications from (cite: Kartaltepe2015) for our galaxies

recipe.method: Select zCOSMOS galaxies z=0.72-0.76 with S100>5 mJy; fit Kirkpatrick2015 SFG template to 24/100 um photometry; SFR_IR=8.6e-11 L_IR plus SFR_UV
assumptions: Chabrier IMF; flat LCDM Om=0.307, H0=67.7

recipe.method: CLEAN natural weighting, 0.4 mJy threshold; taper SG1 to SG2 beam
Integrated flux in 0.54" radius aperture on primary-beam-corrected map, divided by pixels/beam (~66.14); noise from 100 random apertures; detection >2 sigma integrated or 3 sigma peak
Scoville RJ dust-continuum formula with alpha_850=6.7e19 erg/s/Hz/Msun, Gamma_RJ correction
assumptions: T_d = 25 K; optically thin RJ tail; lambda_rest > 250 um

recipe.method: Weighted-mean (inverse-variance) and median stacks in three density bins chosen via sliding boxcar average of 8 samples; M_ISM from bin mean z, nu, d_L

recipe.goal: Derive gas fraction and depletion time
recipe.method: f_gas = M_ISM/(M_ISM+M*); tau = M_ISM/SFR; compare with Tacconi2018/Carilli2013 redshift evolution

evidence.quote: Of the 101 galaxies, 68 are significantly detected in our ALMA band 7 data.
We find an optimal aperture with radius $0.54\ensuremath{''}$
galaxies at intermediate densities have ISM masses higher by a factor of $1.5 \pm 0.2$
galaxies in the highest density bin have ISM masses lower by a factor of $0.7 \pm 0.2$
the ISM mass decreases by a factor of $2.1 \pm 0.6$ ($\sim 2\sigma$)
we find a AD statistic of 2.5 between the mm fluxes in the intermediate and high densities bins
